section.title: Examples of Accessing the API
section.p: See Authenticate page to acquire a token.

sectiondiv.p: The following example shows how to use curl to List reviews for a product.
The following example shows how to use Python to List reviews for a product.
sectiondiv.codeblock: import requests headers = { "Authorization": "<auth-token>" } url = "https://" + SERVER_URL + "/api/v1/products/{productId}/reviews" resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
